name: Fluclotizolam
summary: A derivative of Etizolam. There are conflicting reports on its dosage, though reports have suggested that it is approximately 3x the potency of Etizolam, with a shorter half-life.
advisory: These doses are extremely tentative and will vary from user to user depending on many factors including, but not limited to, tolerance.
